# Stride instructions for Copilot

The rules for this repository are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the root, and in the `AGENTS.md` files of the folders you work in. When you review a pull request, also follow [REVIEW.md](../REVIEW.md). Read them before you change or review code.

This file exists for the Copilot tools that read only `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (Copilot Chat in Visual Studio and JetBrains, code review in the IDEs). Keep the rules in `AGENTS.md` and `REVIEW.md`, not here.
